test_objective: Verify that a positive speed reference produces positive steady-state motor speed.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and no prior reference is applied.
expected_behavior: With SpeedRef held at +5 rps, the steady-state MotorSpeed is positive.
rationale: Represents the positive non-zero reference partition for bidirectional operation.

test_objective: Verify that a negative speed reference produces negative steady-state motor speed.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and no prior reference is applied.
expected_behavior: With SpeedRef held at -5 rps, the steady-state MotorSpeed is negative.
rationale: Represents the negative non-zero reference partition for bidirectional operation.

test_objective: Verify positive-direction operation at a low positive reference.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and no prior reference is applied.
expected_behavior: With SpeedRef held at +0.1 rps, the steady-state MotorSpeed is positive.
rationale: Exercises the positive-reference side close to the zero-direction boundary without using zero.

test_objective: Verify negative-direction operation at a low negative reference.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and no prior reference is applied.
expected_behavior: With SpeedRef held at -0.1 rps, the steady-state MotorSpeed is negative.
rationale: Exercises the negative-reference side close to the zero-direction boundary without using zero.

test_objective: Verify positive-direction operation at a high nominal reference magnitude.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and no prior reference is applied.
expected_behavior: With SpeedRef held at +19.9 rps, the steady-state MotorSpeed is positive.
rationale: Exercises the upper side of the stated nominal SpeedRef domain while retaining a positive reference.

test_objective: Verify negative-direction operation at a high nominal reference magnitude.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and no prior reference is applied.
expected_behavior: With SpeedRef held at -19.9 rps, the steady-state MotorSpeed is negative.
rationale: Exercises the lower side of the stated nominal SpeedRef domain while retaining a negative reference.

test_objective: Verify reversal from positive steady operation to negative operation.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest; hold each sequence value long enough to establish the specified operating phase before advancing.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed initially operates in the positive direction, transitions after the sign reversal, and converges stably to the negative reference direction.
rationale: Directly exercises the required positive-to-negative reversal sequence.

test_objective: Verify reversal from negative steady operation to positive operation.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest; hold each sequence value long enough to establish the specified operating phase before advancing.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed initially operates in the negative direction, transitions after the sign reversal, and converges stably to the positive reference direction.
rationale: Directly exercises the required negative-to-positive reversal sequence.

test_objective: Verify a low-magnitude positive-to-negative reversal.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest; hold each sequence value long enough to establish the specified operating phase before advancing.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from positive operation to negative operation and converges stably to the final negative reference direction.
rationale: Exercises reversal near the zero-reference boundary while using non-zero references.

test_objective: Verify a low-magnitude negative-to-positive reversal.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest; hold each sequence value long enough to establish the specified operating phase before advancing.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from negative operation to positive operation and converges stably to the final positive reference direction.
rationale: Exercises reversal near the zero-reference boundary in the opposite direction.

test_objective: Verify a high-magnitude positive-to-negative reversal within the nominal reference domain.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest; hold each sequence value long enough to establish the specified operating phase before advancing.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from positive operation to negative operation and converges stably to the final negative reference direction.
rationale: Exercises both reversal directions at high nominal reference magnitude.

test_objective: Verify repeated bidirectional reversals.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest; hold each sequence value long enough to establish the specified operating phase before advancing.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions through the commanded directions and converges stably to the final positive reference direction.
rationale: Exercises more than one sign transition and verifies the final direction after repeated reversals.

test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a moderate positive constant reference.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and the reference is maintained constantly.
expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained +5 rps reference without persistent actuator saturation.
rationale: Represents nominal positive constant tracking under the stated non-saturation condition.

test_objective: Verify stable tracking of a moderate negative constant reference.

expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the maintained -5 rps reference without persistent actuator saturation.

test_objective: Verify voltage limitation during a moderate positive command.
precondition: DUT is initialized at rest and the positive reference is maintained for the complete simulation interval.
expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd observed over the complete simulation interval remain within -12 V to +12 V.
rationale: Represents a nominal positive operating case for complete-interval voltage observation.
